zh: 这条任务所属的聊天实例已结束，请从启动页重新进入。
en: This task's chat instance has ended. Open the workspace from the start page.

zh: 无法打开该任务的会话，当前聊天已保留。
en: The task's session could not be opened. Your current chat was kept.

zh: 手机任务状态与悬浮窗权限
en: Phone task status and overlay permission

zh: 允许悬浮窗（离开应用后仍可聊天和停止）
en: Allow overlay to chat and stop from other apps

zh: 本机 DSH 正在启动，准备好后会自动显示会话。
en: Local DSH is starting. Conversations will appear when it is ready.

zh: 本机运行状态待核对。请在本机工作台查看诊断后继续。
en: Local runtime status needs checking. Open the local workspace to review diagnostics.

zh: 本机 DSH 尚未运行。先在本机工作台启动，再返回这里选择会话。
en: Local DSH is stopped. Start it in the local workspace, then return to choose a conversation.

zh: DSH 已运行，但悬浮助手接口尚未加载。请正常停止并重新启动本机 DSH，再刷新。
en: DSH is running, but its assistant interface is unavailable. Stop and restart local DSH normally, then refresh.

zh: 暂时无法连接本机 DSH 会话。请刷新，或打开本机工作台检查运行状态。
en: Unable to reach local conversations. Refresh or open the local workspace to check its status.

zh: 新建结果待核对，请刷新会话列表
en: Creation result unknown; refresh conversations before retrying

zh: 目标未提供有效会话列表，请刷新或打开完整 DSH。
en: The target did not provide a valid conversation list. Refresh or open the full DSH interface.

zh: 还没有会话。新建后即可在这里输入文字、语音，并从悬浮条查看回复、暂停或停止任务。模型与密钥在 DSH 网页中设置。
en: No conversations yet. Create one to type or dictate a message, read replies, pause, or stop from the floating strip. Configure your model and key in DSH.

zh: 已选择会话：%s。悬浮条或通知可展开聊天。
en: Selected conversation: %s. Open chat from the floating strip or notification.

zh: 向当前绑定会话发送消息
打开完整 DSH 会话 / 模型设置
en: Open full DSH conversation / model settings
Collapse and return to other apps

zh: 在下方输入消息开始对话。模型和 API Key 请先在完整 DSH 会话中设置。
en: Type below to begin. Configure your model and API key in the full DSH conversation first.

zh: 已允许悬浮窗。请返回原对话明确继续；不会自动执行。
en: Overlay permission allowed. Return to the original conversation and explicitly continue; execution is not automatic.

zh: 手机任务需要悬浮窗权限
本次手机工具尚未执行。请打开 DSHA 设置中的悬浮窗权限，或系统设置 → 应用 → 特殊应用权限 → 显示在其他应用上层 → DSHA。允许后回到原对话明确继续；不会自动重放。
en: This phone tool has not executed. Open overlay permission in DSHA settings, or Android Settings → Apps → Special app access → Display over other apps → DSHA. After allowing it, return to this conversation and explicitly continue. Nothing is replayed automatically.

zh: 手机控制已在本机暂停。请在当前任务悬浮界面或通知中继续；不要重复操作工具。
en: Phone control is paused locally. Continue from the current task overlay or notification; do not repeat the phone action.

zh: 另一会话仍在执行手机任务。请先在手机上结束或检查该任务，再回到原对话继续。
en: Another conversation still owns the phone task. End or inspect it on the phone before continuing this conversation.

zh: 手机任务状态界面尚未就绪，工具未开始执行。请检查当前 DSH 会话与连接，并从手机前台打开原对话后再明确继续。
en: The phone task status interface is unavailable; this tool has not started. Check the current DSH conversation and connection, open the original conversation in the foreground on the phone, then explicitly continue.

zh: 允许显示手机任务状态
点按设置悬浮窗权限，然后返回原对话继续
en: Tap to allow overlays, then return to the original conversation

zh: 查看绑定会话；暂停或停止当前任务
en: View conversation; pause or stop the current task

zh: 取消结果未知；正在核对会话状态
en: Cancellation result unknown; checking conversation state

zh: 继续当前任务。操作手机前必须重新观察当前屏幕，再决定下一步；不要重放结果未知的操作。
en: Continue the current task. Observe the current phone screen again before deciding the next action. Do not replay operations with unknown results.

zh: 另一项手机任务仍占用控制权。请先结束该任务，再发送或继续。
en: Another phone task still owns control. End that task before sending or continuing.

zh: 消息尚未发送：请打开完整 DSH 会话设置可用模型和 API Key，然后重新发送。草稿已保留。
en: Message not sent. Open the full DSH conversation to configure an available model and API key, then send again. Your draft is retained.

zh: 消息未被接收。请打开完整会话检查模型或会话设置；草稿已保留。
en: Message was not admitted. Open the full conversation to check its model or settings. Your draft is retained.

zh: 发送结果未知；请先核对会话，勿重复发送
en: Send result unknown; check the conversation before sending again

zh: 本轮执行失败。请打开完整 DSH 会话查看错误，并检查模型、密钥或网络设置。
en: This turn failed. Open the full DSH conversation to review the error and check your model, key, or network settings.

zh: 状态暂不可确认；手机操作已暂停
无法打开绑定会话；连接可能已改变
en: Unable to open the bound conversation; the connection may have changed

zh: 语音输入：识别结果将作为草稿，不会自动发送。
en: Voice input adds a draft. It is not sent automatically.

zh: 系统语音识别不可用，请返回文字输入。
en: System speech recognition is unavailable. Use text input.

zh: 麦克风权限未授予，请返回文字输入。
en: Microphone permission was not granted. Use text input.

zh: 无法启动系统语音识别，请返回文字输入。
en: Unable to start speech recognition. Use text input.

zh: 语音识别未完成（%s），请返回文字输入。
en: Speech recognition did not finish (%s). Use text input.

zh: 聊天已展开，手机操作已暂停。核对停止状态后可发送新消息；收起后点继续恢复任务。
en: Phone actions are paused while chatting. Once cancellation is confirmed, send a message or collapse and continue the task.

zh: 任务已暂停。确认停止后，点继续会先重新观察屏幕。
en: Task paused. Continue after cancellation is confirmed to observe the screen again.

zh: 下一次手机操作前会重新观察屏幕。
en: The screen must be observed again before the next phone action.

zh: 已暂停手机操作，正在打开完整会话。
en: Phone actions paused; opening the full conversation.

zh: 连接已改变。返回悬浮助手重新选择会话。
en: The connection changed. Choose a conversation again in the assistant.

zh: 当前任务已停止。输入新消息可在此会话开始新任务。
en: Task stopped. Send a new message to begin another task in this conversation.

zh: 手机操作已暂停；确认会话状态后继续。
en: Phone actions paused; check the conversation before continuing.

zh: 备份未完成：%s。未自动重新启动 DSH。
en: Backup did not finish: %s. DSH was not automatically restarted.

zh: 已请求取消，等待当前安全步骤结束。DSH 不会自动重新启动。
en: Cancellation requested; waiting for the current safe step to finish. DSH will not restart automatically.

zh: 首次备份请选择保存目录，之后会复用此授权。
en: Choose a backup folder once; its grant will be reused.

zh: 备份未完成：%s。原数据和已有备份保留。
en: Backup did not finish: %s. Original data and existing backups were retained.

zh: 备份完成，目标文件已读回校验。可手动启动 DSH。
en: Backup complete; the destination was read back and verified. Start DSH manually when ready.

zh: 备份已保存，但插件依赖有缺失或未确认项。请查看备份详情。
en: Backup saved with missing or unverified plugin dependencies. Review backup details.

zh: 文件已写入，但目标未完成读回校验，不能视为已验证备份。
en: The file was written, but destination readback was not verified; this is not a verified backup.

zh: 仅保存部分数据，不能视为完整备份。
en: Only part of the data was saved; this is not a complete backup.

zh: 尽力导出，未承诺应用级一致性。
en: Best-effort export without an application-consistency guarantee.

zh: 备份已取消，未自动重新启动 DSH。
en: Backup cancelled; DSH was not automatically restarted.

zh: 本机有可用的 API Key。
en: An API key is available on this device.

zh: 本机尚无可用 API Key，请在配置页填写或明确选择恢复历史凭据。
en: No API key is currently available. Enter one in Configuration or explicitly choose historical credential restore.

zh: 旧 Ubuntu 系统已清理，个人数据验证副本与事务记录保留。
en: The old Ubuntu system was cleaned. Verified personal-data copies and transaction records remain.

zh: 环境重建完成，数据逐文件核验与运行试验通过。
en: Environment rebuilt; data verification and the runtime trial passed.

zh: 中断的首次安装已在宿主侧恢复，原件和失败候选继续保留。
en: Interrupted first installation recovered on the host; originals and failed candidates are retained.

zh: 中断的 profile 设置事务已恢复，原件保留。
en: Interrupted profile settings transaction recovered; originals retained.

zh: 导出结构化状态、现有脱敏操作记录尾部及摘要。不主动采集业务正文，但自由格式错误可能包含业务内容，分享前请检查。可仅本次附加主动填写的说明。
en: Export structured state, existing redacted operation tails and a summary. Business bodies are not actively collected, but free-form errors may contain business content; review before sharing. You may attach the context entered here for this export only.

zh: 不主动采集业务正文；现有操作尾部的自由格式错误仍可能包含业务内容。历史时间与阶段前缀未经认证，缺失历史不能补回。分享前请检查内容。
en: Business bodies are not actively collected, but existing free-form operation errors may contain business content. Historical time/stage prefixes are not authenticated and missing history cannot be reconstructed. Review before sharing.

zh: 现存内容与旧依赖记录不同；已按本次内容重新核对。
en: Existing content differs from the old dependency record; the current content was checked.

zh: 作者声明（未作为本机验证结论）：
安装后默认启用；Web 启动时加载，同名更新保留上一版。
en: Enabled by default after installation; Web loads it on startup. Updates retain the previous version.

zh: 正在处理启用或回退；启动 Web 后生效。
en: Applying enable or rollback; the change takes effect on Web startup.

zh: 插件将在 DSHA 的权限范围内运行。
en: The plugin runs with DSHA's permissions.

zh: 正在读取插件能力声明…
静态能力信息（声明与源码线索，不代表权限或安全保证）
en: Static capabilities (declarations and source references, not permissions or safety guarantees)

zh: 历史记录无此信息；可在详情中重新检查。
en: No information in this historical record; inspect again from plugin details.

zh: 已读依赖 manifests / 脚本声明：
未跟踪补丁引用与动态加载模块
en: Patch references and dynamically loaded modules were not followed

zh: 重导出的服务声明未确认
动态设备桥调用未确认
en: Dynamic device bridge calls are unconfirmed

zh: 依赖脚本声明未完整检查
en: Dependency script declarations were not fully inspected

zh: 静态解析器不可用或超出预算
en: Static parser unavailable or budget exceeded
Package declaration input could not be confirmed

zh: 正在恢复未完成的插件安装…
正在准备旧预设候选与当前依赖…
en: Preparing the legacy preset and current dependencies…

zh: 插件包已解析，正在安装并启用
en: Plugin package resolved; installing and enabling

zh: 插件已安装并启用；Web 未自动重启，请在启动页重试
en: Plugin installed and enabled; restart Web from the launch page

zh: LEGACY_NATIVE_KEY_%s/%s: 旧原生 API Key 无法读取，原记录已保留。本次不注入兼容凭据；可继续在网页配置模型和凭据。
en: LEGACY_NATIVE_KEY_%s/%s: The legacy native API key is unavailable and its saved record was retained. No compatibility key will be injected; configure the model and credentials in Web.

zh: 格式化已停止更新任务

en: Waiting for a fresh update check

zh: 此通道上次结果已保留，可重试检查或使用已下载包
en: The previous result for this channel is kept. Retry the check or use the downloaded package.

zh: 已重新接入原 Web 实例
en: Reconnected to the existing Web instance

zh: 正在核对原 Web 实例，请稍后重试
en: Checking the existing Web instance. Try again shortly.

zh: 网页已就绪；部分旧数据仍待处理，请在保留数据中检查迁移记录。
en: The web service is ready; some legacy data needs attention in Retained data.

zh: 正在准备启动 Web · 后台保护中
en: Preparing Web startup · background protection active

zh: 正在验证原 Web 状态 · 保留后台保护
en: Verifying the existing Web session · background protection retained

zh: 正在建立后台保护并准备启动 Web
en: Establishing protection and preparing Web startup

zh: [POLICY_BLOCKED] 短信读取已关闭，请在设备能力授权中开启
en: [POLICY_BLOCKED] SMS reading is off. Enable it in Device permissions

zh: 应急 DSH 尚未启动
正在准备独立应急 DSH…
正在重新核验应急进程退出…
en: Checking whether the recovery process exited…

zh: 正在停止应急 DSH，原会话将保留…
en: Stopping recovery DSH; its session will be retained…

zh: 尚未配置模型凭据，可返回原生应急页面填写本次临时密钥。
en: No model credential is configured. Enter a temporary key on the native recovery page.

zh: 原生凭据暂不可读取，已保留原密文；可填写本次临时密钥。
en: The saved credential is unavailable and has been preserved. You can enter a temporary key.

zh: 正在启动空白 DSH，等待受控工具检查与鉴权…
en: Starting a blank DSH; waiting for tool verification and authentication…

zh: 系统限制进程身份读取；应急对话与只读诊断可用，正式环境写入仍被阻止。
en: The system restricts process identity access. Recovery chat and read-only diagnostics are available; writes to the main environment remain blocked.

zh: 独立应急 DSH 已就绪；正式环境保持原状。
en: Independent recovery DSH is ready. The main environment is preserved.

zh: 应急 DSH 仍在启动，可继续等待或停止；详细原因显示在本页。
en: Recovery DSH is still starting. You can wait or stop it; details remain available here.

zh: 尚未确认应急进程退出，现场已保留；可重试停止。
en: Recovery process exit is unconfirmed. Records are preserved; you can retry stopping.

zh: 应急 DSH 已停止，应急会话及诊断原件已保留。
en: Recovery DSH stopped. Its session and original diagnostics are preserved.

zh: 正在核验独立应急运行时…
应急运行时副本校验失败，正在从签名安装包重建…
en: The recovery runtime copy failed verification. Rebuilding from the signed APK…

zh: 正在复用已完整核验的应急候选…
en: Reusing a fully verified recovery candidate…

zh: 已确认的原生修复仍在执行，可打开查看结果。
en: An approved native repair is still running. Open to review its result.

zh: 下载服务已暂停，请在文件页继续
在文件页查看下载记录
系统已暂停长时间下载，进度保留，请手动继续
en: System time limit; progress kept for manual resume

zh: 下载服务中断，进度保留
DSHA 与随包第三方组件
无法读取随包许可清单。
en: Unable to read the bundled license list.
Unable to read this license text.

zh: ADB 已关闭，配对密钥保留。需要时可验证连接重新启用。
en: ADB disabled. Pairing keys are retained; verify the connection to enable it again.

zh: 请填写本机无线调试显示的 IP
en: Enter this device's wireless debugging IP

zh: 端口应为 1–65535，或留空自动发现
en: Use a port from 1–65535, or leave blank

zh: 配对端口来自六位码弹窗；连接端口来自无线调试主页面。
en: Pairing port comes from the code dialog; connection port comes from the main Wireless debugging page.

zh: 配对端口 · 留空自动发现
连接端口 · 留空自动发现
连接设置已保存，可开始配对或验证已有连接。
en: Connection settings saved. Pair or verify the existing connection.

zh: 端口应为 1–65535，或留空自动发现。
en: Use a port from 1–65535, or leave blank.

zh: 查看实际对话进度。停止只作用于对应任务。显示最多 32 个活动任务及最近 5 个结束状态。
en: View actual conversation progress. Stop affects only the selected task. Shows up to 32 active tasks and the 5 most recent ended states.

zh: 麦克风未获授权，可在系统应用权限中允许后重试。
en: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in system app permissions and retry.

zh: 请先启动 DSH，再恢复旧端口草稿。
en: Start DSH before restoring previous-port drafts.

zh: 没有其它已记录端口。当前端口的草稿仍在原网页内。
en: There are no other recorded ports. Current-port drafts remain in the current browser.

zh: 已有恢复操作，请先完成或返回关闭该操作。
en: A restore is already open. Finish it or return to close it first.

zh: 运行实例已变化，请返回后重试。
en: The running instance changed. Return and retry.

zh: 正在核对旧端口与保留候选…
en: Checking the previous port and retained candidates…

zh: 正在读取旧端口的数据候选；原数据不会删除。
en: Reading previous-port candidates; source data will be retained.

zh: 恢复页面无法打开，候选已保留。
en: The recovery page could not open. Candidates were retained.

zh: 旧端口正被占用，草稿仍保留。请待端口释放后从“恢复旧端口草稿”重试。
en: The previous port is occupied. Drafts were retained. Retry after the port is released.

zh: 未确认旧网页已关闭，恢复尚未开始。请关闭其它对话页后重试。
en: Previous pages have not confirmed closure. Restore has not started. Close other conversation pages and retry.

zh: 恢复候选达到保留上限，旧草稿仍保留。请保留原图并联系维护者检查候选。
en: Retained recovery candidates reached their limit. Old drafts remain. Keep original images and contact the maintainer to inspect candidates.

zh: 恢复未开始，旧数据仍保留。请返回后重试。
en: Restore did not start. Source data was retained. Return and retry.

zh: 运行实例已变化；旧数据与候选已保留，请返回后重试。
en: The running instance changed. Source and candidates were retained. Return and retry.

zh: 候选已保存，恢复尚未完成。
en: Candidates were saved; restore is incomplete.

zh: 暂停屏幕操作并撤销预授权
en: Pause screen actions and revoke preauthorizations

zh: 已暂停屏幕操作并撤销预授权；可点恢复后继续
en: Screen actions are paused and preauthorizations revoked. Use Resume to continue

zh: 全局权限已开启：已授权能力免 DSHA 安全确认。可编辑下列保留规则；关闭全局后按这些规则确认。独立撤销或暂停仍有效。
en: Global permission is on: authorized capabilities skip DSHA confirmation. You can edit the retained rules below; they apply when global permission is off. Explicit revocation or pause remains effective.

zh: 仅设置 DSHA 的屏幕确认；不会授予系统权限。全部允许包含敏感界面；自定义中未配置的应用仍询问。规则保存在本机，不随备份迁移。
en: These rules only control DSHA confirmations and do not grant system permissions. Allow all includes sensitive screens. Unconfigured apps still ask in custom mode. Rules stay on this device and are excluded from backups.

zh: 允许该应用免确认（含敏感界面）
en: Allow this app without confirmation, including sensitive screens

zh: 应用包名无效，规则未保存
en: Invalid package name. Rule was not saved

zh: 已开启：可读写系统允许的共享存储；其他应用私有目录仍受系统限制
en: Allowed: shared storage permitted by Android; other apps' private directories remain restricted

zh: 请打开失败卡片查看原因，也可复制或导出脱敏报告。
en: Open the failure card for details, or copy or export the redacted report.

zh: 仅本次附加本页主动填写的说明
en: Attach the context entered on this page for this export only

zh: 包含结构化状态、现有脱敏操作记录尾部和摘要。原始进程输出、完整异常链及未采集的历史不会补入。附加说明默认不选，仅包含本页输入，不开启自动业务记录。
en: Includes structured state, existing redacted operation tails and a summary. Raw process output, full exception chains and uncollected history are unavailable. Additional context is off by default and contains only this page's input; it enables no automatic business capture.

zh: 旧记录未提供；请查看维护日志
en: Not available in the old record; inspect maintenance logs

zh: 后台启动保护未能建立，请保持应用在前台后重试。
en: Background startup protection could not be established. Keep the app visible and retry.

zh: 不再询问 DSHA 安全确认

DSHA 不做任何后台屏幕记录：读屏只发生在助手明确请求的那一刻，读屏文字和 MCP 截图返回本次对话；普通截图按请求保存到应用私有截图目录。DSHA 不会单独自动上传截图，模型/插件对返回结果的处理由当前配置决定；配对码只在你点过「自动读配对码」后的两分钟内读取。

Screen contents are read only when the assistant explicitly requests them, returned to the current conversation. zh: 开启一次，之后直接在对话里说出要做的事。
en: Enable once, then describe what you want in a conversation.

zh: 点下方按钮 → 已下载的应用 / 服务 → DSHA 配对助手 → 开启「使用服务」，确认系统提示。
en: Tap below → Downloaded apps / services → DSHA Pairing Assistant → Enable the service, then confirm the system prompt.

zh:
在 DSH 对话中发送：
“请打开系统设置，查看当前的显示设置。”

首次操作按应用提示确认。你可以随时在系统无障碍设置中关闭服务。读屏与点按无需 Root、Shizuku 或 ADB；如果已完成 ADB 配对，后台保活会在部分系统掉线后请求重新绑定。截屏需要 Android 11+。
en:
In a DSH conversation, ask:
“Open system settings and inspect the display settings.”

Confirm the app prompt when requested. You can disable the service in Accessibility settings at any time. Observation and taps do not require Root, Shizuku or ADB. If ADB pairing is enabled, the watchdog can request a rebind after some ROMs disconnect the service. Screenshots require Android 11+.

zh: 找不到开关或开关是灰色

部分手机路径是：设置 → 更多设置 → 无障碍 → 已下载的服务。

Android 13+ 若提示“受限设置”，在系统应用详情右上角菜单允许受限设置，再返回无障碍页面。只有你确认信任已安装的 DSHA 时才启用。

开启后仍未连接，可关闭再开启服务，并允许 DSHA 后台运行。
en:
Some devices use Settings → Additional settings → Accessibility → Downloaded services.

On Android 13+, if the system reports restricted settings, use the app-info menu to allow restricted settings, then return to Accessibility. Enable only for your trusted DSHA installation.

If disconnected after enabling, toggle the service off and on and allow DSHA to run in the background.

zh: 请打开系统设置 → 无障碍 → DSHA 配对助手。
en: Open Settings → Accessibility → DSHA Pairing Assistant.

zh: 尚未开启，请完成第 1 步。
写入并验证无密码副本
en: Writing and verifying an unencrypted copy

zh: 默认开启。备份对话、附件、配置和插件；不重复备份 Ubuntu。个人项目请使用手动备份。
en: On by default. Saves conversations, attachments, settings and plugins, without copying Ubuntu. Use manual backup for personal projects.

zh: 到期时仍在运行则延后，不会停止对话或终端。时间由系统调度，可能略有延迟。保留最近 3 份已验证自动副本。关闭后取消后续任务，已有副本保留。
en: If DSH or a terminal is running, backup waits. Android scheduling may delay the selected time. Keeps the latest 3 verified automatic copies. Turning off cancels future jobs and preserves existing copies.

zh: 自动副本与本机密钥在卸载时会清除。换机或卸载前，请导出无需密码的 tar.gz 并保存到应用外。
en: Local copies and their device key are removed when the app is uninstalled. Export a tar.gz without a password and save it outside the app before moving or uninstalling.

zh: 备份任务进行中，请等待完成。
en: A backup task is running. Wait for it to finish.

zh: 已安排：DSH 和终端停止后可执行，稍后刷新查看结果。
en: Scheduled. DSH and terminals must be stopped. Refresh shortly to view the result.

zh: 已开启 · 等待到期且 DSH 停止
en: On · waiting for the scheduled time and DSH to stop

zh: 数据已保存；部分插件依赖需在恢复预检中核对。
en: Data saved; some plugin dependencies need review before restore.

zh: 还没有自动备份。到达所选时间后，在 DSH 停止且没有终端任务时创建第一份。
en: No automatic backup yet. The first copy is created when due, with DSH and terminals stopped.

zh: 查看正在执行的操作和进度。需要取消时，请进入对应页面。
en: View active operations and progress. Open the related page to cancel safely.

zh: 当前没有原生后台任务。
en: No native background tasks are running.

zh: 已取消另存为，已校验文件仍保留在下载记录中，可稍后继续保存。
en: Save as was cancelled. The verified file remains in history to save later.

zh: 原下载记录已不可用，请重新选择记录。
en: The original transfer is unavailable. Select the record again.

zh: 文件提供方没有返回可用的文档位置。
en: The provider did not return a usable document location.

zh: 同名文件自动使用新名称。移除记录不会删除已完成文件；分享选择器打开不代表对方已收到。
en: Duplicate names use a new name. Removing a record keeps completed files. Opening the share picker does not confirm delivery.

zh: 正在准备分享，校验完成后将打开系统分享选择器。
en: Preparing to share. The system share picker will open after verification.

zh: 正在准备另存为，完成后请选择保存位置。
en: Preparing Save as. Choose a destination when ready.

zh: 自动打开已取消，文件仍保留在记录中，可手动继续分享或保存。
en: Automatic opening was cancelled. The file remains in history to share or save manually.

zh: 暂无下载记录。网页文件菜单中的下载会显示在这里。
en: No downloads yet. Downloads from the web file menu appear here.

zh: 分享文件已就绪；打开分享选择器不代表对方已收到。
en: The file is ready to share. Opening the share picker does not confirm delivery.

zh: 文件操作失败，请在当前记录中查看原因并重试。
en: File operation failed. Check this record for the reason and retry.

zh: 文件操作已暂停，可在当前记录中继续。
en: File operation paused. Resume it from this record.

zh: 文件准备已停止，请在记录中查看原因并手动继续。
en: File preparation stopped. Check the record and continue manually.

zh: 请先完成当前保存位置选择。
en: Complete the current destination picker first.

zh: 系统文件保存界面不可用，请稍后重试。
en: The system save picker is unavailable. Try again later.

zh: 没有可打开此类文件的应用，可使用分享选择其他应用。
en: No app can open this file type. Try sharing it to another app.

zh: 系统不保证能按此文档精确定位文件夹。下方可打开系统下载列表；图库及其他文件提供方保存的文件可能不在该列表中。
en: The system does not guarantee exact folder navigation for this document. You can open the system Downloads list below; gallery files and files saved by other providers may not appear there.

zh: 此设备没有提供系统下载列表，请按上方真实位置在文件管理器中查找。
en: This device has no system Downloads list. Use the saved location above in your file manager.

zh: 只移除此条下载记录，已完成文件仍保留在原保存位置。
en: Only this download record will be removed. Completed files stay in their saved location.

zh: 已校验，等待选择保存位置
存储空间不足。请释放空间后重试；已完成文件不会被覆盖。
en: Not enough storage. Free some space and retry. Completed files will not be overwritten.

zh: 无法访问保存位置。请检查文件权限，或重新选择保存位置。
en: Cannot access the destination. Check file permissions or choose another destination.

zh: 文件身份或完整性校验未通过，未发布文件。请重新获取下载。
en: File identity or integrity verification failed. No file was published. Request a new download.

zh: 当前网页运行环境已停止、切换或未就绪。请确认网页正常后重试，下载记录仍保留。
en: The web runtime stopped, changed, or is not ready. Check that the web app is ready and retry. The download record is retained.

zh: 文件访问未获授权。请返回当前网页重新获取下载。
en: File access was not authorized. Request the download again from the current web page.

zh: 源文件已不可用。请返回网页重新获取文件。
en: The source file is no longer available. Request the file again from the web app.

zh: 传输中断或文件服务暂不可用。已下载进度保留，请检查运行环境后重试。
en: The transfer was interrupted or the file service is unavailable. Downloaded progress is retained. Check the runtime and retry.

zh: 下载长度或续传响应校验失败，未发布文件。请重新获取下载。
en: Download size or resume response verification failed. No file was published. Request a new download.

zh: 文件超过当前单个文件 5 GB 的上限。
en: The file exceeds the current 5 GB per-file limit.

zh: 下载记录已达上限，请移除不再需要的记录后重试。已完成文件会保留。
en: Download history is full. Remove unneeded records and retry. Completed files will be kept.

zh: 文件未通过真实图片校验，未写入相册。可从网页选择普通下载。
en: The file did not pass image verification and was not saved to the gallery. Use a regular download from the web app.

zh: 下载器正在完成本条记录的收尾，请稍后再移除。
en: The downloader is finishing this record. Try removing it again shortly.

zh: 无法完成文件保存。请确认保存位置仍可用后重试；另存为可重新选择位置。
en: The file could not be saved. Check that the destination is available and retry. Save As lets you choose a destination again.

zh: 下载记录或完成文件已不可用，请重新获取文件。
en: The download record or completed file is unavailable. Request the file again.

zh: 已取消。需要再次下载请从网页重新发起。
en: Cancelled. To download again, start a new download from the web app.

zh: 局域网代理已监听，检测到 IPv6，但没有可分享的私有 IPv4 地址；此代理使用 IPv4。请连接提供私有 IPv4 地址的 Wi-Fi 或以太网。
en: The LAN listener is ready. IPv6 was detected, but no shareable private IPv4 address is available. This proxy uses IPv4. Connect to Wi-Fi or Ethernet that provides private IPv4.

zh: 局域网代理已监听，但没有可分享的 Wi-Fi 或以太网私有 IPv4 地址。请连接局域网后刷新；VPN 或移动数据地址不会作为局域网链接。
en: The LAN listener is ready, but no shareable Wi-Fi or Ethernet private IPv4 address is available. Connect to a LAN and refresh. VPN and cellular addresses are excluded.

zh: 应用在选择保存位置期间重新启动，请重新发起导出。
en: The app restarted while choosing a destination. Start the export again.

zh: 导出、导入和自动备份集中在这里。
en: Export, import and automatic backups in one place.

zh: 选择范围和项目后，导出无需密码的 tar.gz 备份。
en: Choose data and projects, then export a tar.gz backup without a password.

zh: 先验证备份内容，再确认恢复范围。
en: Verify backup contents before confirming what to restore.

zh: 运行环境不可用时，也能检查并保护可读取的数据。
en: Inspect and protect readable data even when the runtime is unavailable.

zh: 查看保留副本、旧环境和插件原件；检查与恢复分别处理。
en: Browse retained copies, old environments, and original plugins. Inspection and restoration are separate actions.

zh: 选择已验证的备份副本
将核对私有副本并导出无需密码的 tar.gz。原副本保留，不重新读取工作目录，也不覆盖已有备份。
en: Verify the private copy and export a tar.gz without a password. The original is retained, the workspace is not read again, and existing backups are preserved.

zh: 救援不会停止当前写入，结果将标明尽力救援或部分数据。不能据此删除原件。导出为无需密码的 tar.gz。
en: Rescue does not stop current writers. The result is best-effort or partial and cannot justify deleting originals. The tar.gz export needs no password.

zh: 将停止 Web、终端和写入任务后建立快照，导出无需密码的 tar.gz 备份。
en: Web, terminals and write tasks stop before the snapshot. The tar.gz backup needs no password.

zh: 这是以前用密码加密的副本。原密码只用于读取旧副本；新导出的 tar.gz 无需密码，原加密副本保留。
en: This older copy was encrypted. Its original password is only used to read it. The new tar.gz needs no password, and the encrypted original is retained.
Original password of the old copy

zh: 请输入旧副本原来的密码
en: Enter the original password of the old copy

zh: 这是以前用密码加密的备份，需要原密码才能读取。先在私有目录验证，确认前不会覆盖当前数据。
en: This older backup was encrypted and needs its original password to be read. Verification uses private staging and does not overwrite current data before confirmation.

zh: 此备份无需输入密码。先在私有目录验证内容和实际范围，确认前不会覆盖当前数据。
en: No password entry is required. Contents and actual scope are verified privately before you confirm any change.
Original password of the old backup

zh: 这是未加密的 v5 备份；摘要能校验文件完整性，但不能提供保密或来源认证。
en: This is an unencrypted v5 backup; the digest verifies file integrity but provides no confidentiality or sender authentication.

zh: 所选数据已保存。Profile 设置尚未应用：请进入「保留副本与旧树」逐个 profile 检查差异、选择字段并读回；插件和代码仍待审阅。
en: Selected data saved. Profile settings are pending: open Retained copies and old trees to inspect each profile, select fields and verify readback. Plugins and code still require review.

zh: 原生 API Key 未恢复，请在 Web UI 中确认模型凭据。
en: The native API key was not restored; verify model credentials in Web UI.

zh: 数据已恢复，但备份中的 API Key 无法读取；请在 Web UI 中重新配置模型凭据。
en: Data restored, but the selected API key could not be read. Configure model credentials again in Web UI.

zh: 数据已恢复；本次备份未包含 API Key，请在 Web UI 中配置模型凭据。
en: Data restored; this backup did not include an API key. Configure model credentials in Web UI.

zh: 旧加密副本需要原密码才能读取。原件已保留，可重新选择并输入原密码。
en: The old encrypted copy needs its original password. The original is retained; select it again and enter the original password.

zh: 本机自动副本的解密密钥不可用，原件已保留。可选择其他可读备份。
en: The local automatic-copy decryption key is unavailable. Originals are retained; choose another readable backup.

zh: 正式环境维护失败时，可在这里启动独立的空白 DSH。它可以读取相关故障文件并向当前模型服务发送内容，提出修复方案；每次正式数据写入都需在此确认。
en: Start a separate, empty DSH when the regular environment fails. It can read affected files and send their contents to your model service to propose repairs. Confirm each write to regular data here.

zh: 临时 API Key（可选，仅本次应急会话使用）
en: Temporary API key (optional, this emergency session only)

zh: 留空时尝试已有可读凭据
en: Leave blank to try an existing readable key

zh: 需要更换临时密钥时，请先停止应急 DSH，再填写并重新启动。
en: To change the temporary key, stop emergency DSH, enter the key, then start it again.

zh: 应急服务尚未启动；可先查看错误日志。
en: The emergency service has not started. You can view error logs first.

zh: 查看无需模型的修复选项
请先启动应急服务；无需配置模型。
en: Start the emergency service first. A model is not required.

zh: 重建 Web 基础配置（原件留存）
重建全局配置补丁（影响所有 Profile）
正在核验停止屏障、源摘要并执行修复…
en: Verifying stopped processes and source hashes, then applying the repair…

zh: 应急 DSH 提出方案后在此查看和确认。尚未确认的提案不会修改正式数据。
en: Review and confirm proposals here after emergency DSH creates them. Unconfirmed proposals do not change regular data.

zh: 历史清单已变化，已刷新到第一页。
en: History changed; refreshed to the first page.

zh: 同 ID 重复原件；操作拒绝
将停止 Web、终端和写任务，在独立服务中读取当前 schema 并验证候选；活动设置在确认差异前保持原位。可执行配置和插件构成继续隔离。
en: Web, terminals and writers will stop. An isolated service will validate the candidate against the current schema. Active settings remain unchanged until you confirm the differences; executable configuration and plugin composition stay quarantined.

zh: 正在隔离验证设置；可使用取消检查。
en: Validating settings in isolation; Cancel inspection is available.

zh: 所选设置已事务提交并由实际设置服务读回确认。其它配置和原件保留；可重新进入 Web。
en: Selected settings were committed and read back by the actual settings service. Other configuration and originals remain; you can reopen Web.

zh: 设置操作未完成，原件保留。可重新检查后继续。
en: Settings operation incomplete; originals retained. Inspect again to continue.

zh: 先核对兼容性，通过隔离试运行后再切换。
en: Compatibility and an isolated trial are required before switching.

zh: 将停止 Web、终端和写入任务，复核保留文件，随后在当前 APK 下重新进行隔离试运行。不会恢复旧对话快照。
en: Stop Web, terminals and writers, recheck retained files, then run an isolated trial under this APK. Old conversation snapshots are not restored.

zh: 当前有任务或维护记录需要处理，请稍后重试。
en: A task or maintenance record needs attention. Retry later.

zh: 保护数据并修复运行环境
运行环境的 Bash、启动链接或加载器缺失。请先修复运行环境；对话和配置会单独保护。
en: Bash, its startup link or loader is missing. Repair the runtime first; conversations and configuration will be protected separately.
Start the basic interface in safe mode
Restore the configuration from before the repair

zh: 将使用修复前的快照回退中断的配置写入，然后才能重新启动。
en: Roll back the interrupted configuration changes using the saved pre-repair copy before restarting.

zh: 操作会停止 Web 和终端，并保留修复前配置。
en: This stops Web and terminal sessions and saves the configuration before making changes.

zh: 已有任务进行中，请完成后重试。
en: Another task is in progress. Retry when it finishes.

zh: 将以默认内容替换所选配置。原文件保存到修复前快照，插件文件、会话和原生 API Key 保留。
en: Replace the selected configuration with defaults. Save the original files in a pre-repair snapshot and retain plugin files, sessions, and the native API key.

zh: 运行环境尚未就绪，可先修复配置或导出数据，再进入安装与修复。
en: The runtime is not ready. Repair configuration or export data, then open installation and repair.

zh: 还没有启动记录。下一次启动会自动记录。
en: No startup records yet. The next start will be recorded automatically.
Snapshot is damaged and cannot be restored:

zh: 快照中原本不存在，将恢复为缺失：
en: Absent in this snapshot; restore to absence:

zh: 只恢复这些配置文件；已卸载的插件不会自动重新安装。
en: Restore only these configuration files. Removed plugins are not automatically reinstalled.

zh: 仅卸载所选插件，使用现有插件管理器核验结果。
en: Remove only the selected plugin and verify the result with the plugin manager.

zh: 插件清单暂不可读；可先恢复或新建配置。
en: Cannot read the plugin list. Restore or create configuration first.

zh: 配置修复未完成，请使用“恢复中断的配置修复”。
en: Configuration repair is incomplete. Select Recover interrupted configuration repair.

zh: 环境任务正在执行，完成后刷新即可。
en: An environment task is running. Refresh when it finishes.

zh: 配置文件使用软链接，已保留原文件。请手动检查链接目标。
en: A configuration file uses a symbolic link. The original was retained. Check the link target manually.

zh: 配置快照校验失败，未应用修复。
en: Configuration snapshot validation failed. The repair was not applied.

zh: 配置或快照已变化，请刷新后重新选择。
en: The configuration or snapshot changed. Refresh and select it again.

zh: 配置文件超过快照大小限制或不是普通文件，原文件保留。
en: A configuration file exceeds the snapshot size limit or is not a regular file. The original was retained.

zh: 此页面不依赖 Web。可查看最近启动记录、恢复配置快照，或卸载出错的插件。
en: This page works independently of Web. Review recent starts, restore configuration snapshots, or remove faulty plugins.

zh: 通过以下操作尝试解决启动问题
en: Try these actions to resolve startup problems

zh: 更多高级选项，帮助排查和解决问题
en: More options to diagnose and resolve problems

zh: 保留三次健康启动与三次修复前快照；仅保存配置，不复制会话、工作区或依赖目录。
en: Keeps three healthy-start and three pre-repair snapshots. Saves configuration only, without sessions, workspaces, or dependency directories.

zh: 完整 Linux 环境约占 1 GB。历史环境和回退副本另行保留；它们不等于聊天数据。以下为文件大小估算。
en: The full Linux environment uses about 1 GB. Older environments and rollback copies are retained separately from chats. Sizes below are estimates.

zh: 通过系统文件选择器或 MT 管理器访问 DSHA
en: Access DSHA from the system file picker or MT Manager

zh: 在文件管理器中添加本地存储，选择 DocumentsProvider → DSHA。找不到 DSHA 时，先打开本 App 后重试。
en: Add local storage in your file manager and select DocumentsProvider → DSHA. Open this app first if DSHA is missing.

zh: 清理可再生缓存与多余运行时副本
en: Clean reproducible caches and excess runtime copies

zh: 清理前会安全停止 DSH 和终端，再清理历史验收缓存，以及超过保留数量且已核验的受管回退副本。对话、附件、设置、插件、手动备份和无法核验的原件保留。
en: DSH and terminals are stopped safely before cleanup. Removes old verification caches and verified excess managed rollback copies. Keeps chats, attachments, settings, plugins, manual backups and unverified originals.

zh: 已完成统计。清理只移除可再生缓存和已核验的多余运行时副本，个人数据与备份保留。
en: Sizes updated. Cleanup removes only reproducible caches and verified excess runtime copies. Personal data and backups are retained.

zh: 预览或操作正在更新，本次触摸未发送。请看最新画面后重新操作。
en: The preview or an operation is updating. This touch was not sent. Observe the latest picture before trying again.

zh: 正在发送触摸，请等待结果…
en: Sending touch. Please wait for the result…

zh:
1. 使用标准版，手机系统需为 Android 11 或更高。兼容版暂不支持虚拟屏。

2. 打开“设置 → 设备能力授权”，连接 ADB、Shizuku 或 Root 中的一种通道即可。没有 Root 时，可在系统开发者选项开启“无线调试”，再按 DSHA 的 ADB 配对页提示完成配对与连接。仅打开无线调试开关还不够，请确认通道已连接。

3. 回到“设备能力授权”，点“打开虚拟屏”。在本页点“创建竖屏”或“创建横屏”，等待画面出现。打开此页或开启无障碍，都不会自动创建虚拟屏。

4. 点“应用 → 选择”，选中想操作的应用，再点“启动”，把它打开到虚拟屏。预览里可以点击、滑动；双指用于调整预览。

5. 开启 DSHA 无障碍后，可点“节点操作”，核对实际应用与节点文字，再明确选择点击或输入。输入只在点“设置文字”后提交；每次动作后先看画面，需要继续时手动刷新节点。关闭面板或离开本页会撤销这次节点操作许可。让助手操作时，还要按应用提示确认本次读屏与操作授权，并将操作目标设为虚拟屏。

VSCREEN_NOT_RUNNING 表示虚拟屏还没创建、已经关闭，或连接已断开。先检查设备通道，再点创建按钮；不需要清除数据或重新解压环境。

创建仍失败：到“设置 → 自检与诊断”查看错误记录并导出日志。仅开启无障碍不能解决设备通道或系统兼容问题。

画面持续变化时，预览触摸可能被最新帧检查拒绝；可自行打开“节点操作”，选择系统提供的可操作节点。触摸失败不会自动改用节点，也不会自动重发。系统没有提供节点时不能使用此方式。Android 12 上 ADB/Shizuku 通道通常拿不到系统的受信任显示权限，创建会按非受信任显示进行；若系统仍然拒绝，请改用 Root 通道或无障碍屏幕操作。

不用时点本页“关闭”回收虚拟屏；连接断开或授权被撤销后，需要重新连接并创建。
en:
1. Use Standard on Android 11 or later. Low does not support virtual screens yet.

2. Open Settings → Device capability access and connect one channel: ADB, Shizuku, or Root. Without Root, enable Wireless debugging in the system Developer options, then follow DSHA's ADB pairing page to pair and connect. Enabling the system switch alone is not enough; confirm the channel is connected.

3. In Device capability access, tap Open virtual screen. Tap Create portrait or Create landscape here and wait for a picture. Opening this page or enabling accessibility does not create a virtual screen automatically.

4. Tap App → Choose, select an app, then tap Launch to open it on the virtual screen. Tap and swipe in the preview; use two fingers to adjust the preview.

5. Enable DSHA accessibility, then open Node actions. Check the actual app and node label before choosing Click or Enter text. Text is submitted only when you tap Set text. Observe the picture after each action and refresh nodes yourself before continuing. Closing the panel or leaving this page revokes this node session. For assistant control, also confirm this run's screen access when prompted and choose the virtual screen as the action target.

VSCREEN_NOT_RUNNING means no virtual screen has been created, it was closed, or its connection was lost. Check the device channel, then tap a create button. You do not need to clear data or extract the environment again.

If creation still fails, open Settings → Diagnostics to inspect the error record and export logs. Accessibility alone cannot resolve a missing device channel or system compatibility problem.

On a changing screen, preview touches may be refused by the latest-frame check. You can explicitly open Node actions and choose an actionable node supplied by the system. Failed touches never switch to nodes or resend automatically. This method is unavailable when the system provides no nodes. On Android 12 the ADB/Shizuku channel usually cannot hold the trusted-display permission, so creation falls back to a non-trusted display; if the system still refuses, use the Root channel or accessibility screen actions.

Tap Close when finished. After a disconnection or revoked access, reconnect and create the virtual screen again.

zh:
DSHA 3090 桥端点清单（BRIDGE_PROTOCOL=%s）
凭据由宿主写入 /root/.dsh/.bridge_headers；使用 curl -H @/root/.dsh/.bridge_headers，不把 token 写进 URL 或命令参数。
带中文/空格的参数一律用 -G --data-urlencode，别手写 URL 编码。

== 屏幕操作（无障碍服务，不需要 ADB/Shizuku）==
坐标触控仅限物理display 0：先 /app/ui/screenshot，返回 coordinatesAvailable:true 且含 observationId 才可用；dump/tree不签发像素凭据。ID限最新截图、30秒、一次手势；画面/窗口/遮挡/代次变化即拒绝。
文字/节点动作返回 SCREEN_ACTION_SUBMITTED、actionAccepted:true、effectVerified:false 只代表Android接受动作，不证明WebView DOM已变；须重新观察，后续坐标操作须显式取新截图，禁止隐式回退或重放UNKNOWN。
读屏  curl -s -H @/root/.dsh/.bridge_headers "127.0.0.1:3090/app/ui/dump"
      → 每行语义节点附bounds；boundsHaveArea:false没有可触摸面积，不能取中心点触控
点按  curl -s -G 127.0.0.1:3090/app/ui/tap --data-urlencode "text=设置" -H @/root/.dsh/.bridge_headers
      → 优先按文字点：控件位置随滚动/动画变，文字不变。坐标触控须先截图取得 observationId（dump不签发），再用 ?observationId=截图返回的ID&x=&y=
语义滚动 先 /app/ui/tree 或 dump 取 treeId、nodeId 和 supportedActions；/app/ui/node?treeId=返回的树ID&nodeId=返回的节点ID&action=scroll_forward（或 scroll_backward）。只调用节点列出的动作，一次请求后取新树；无障碍接受不代表实际已滚动，不自动改用滑动或重放未知结果。
输入  curl -s -G 127.0.0.1:3090/app/ui/input --data-urlencode "text=内容" -H @/root/.dsh/.bridge_headers
      → 填到当前焦点框；没有焦点先 tap 一下输入框
按键  /app/ui/key?name=back  （back/home/recents/notifications/quicksettings/lock）
长按  /app/ui/tap?observationId=截图返回的ID&x=540&y=1200&gesture=long_press&ms=600
双击  /app/ui/tap?observationId=截图返回的ID&x=540&y=1200&gesture=double_tap（同一Gesture/一次许可）
当前只支持单指触控；多指/缩放不支持。
滑动  /app/ui/swipe?observationId=截图返回的ID&x1=500&y1=1500&x2=500&y2=500&ms=300
截屏  /app/ui/screenshot   → 存 PNG 到应用截图目录并返回路径（不回 base64）
节奏：每次点按/输入后先 dump 再决定下一步，别凭记忆连点。

== 独立虚拟屏（Android 11+） ==
/app/vscreen/create?orientation=portrait  创建虚拟屏；也可选 landscape
/app/vscreen/status  查询 coreInstance、generation、displayId 和状态
$CORE 取自 create/status 返回的 coreInstance；$GEN 取自当前 see 或 tree 的 generation，$FRAME 取自该 see 的 frameSeq，$NODE 取自该 tree 的 nodeId。不要混用不同 Core 或不同观察的身份。
/app/vscreen/launch?coreInstance=$CORE&package=com.example.app  启动已安装应用；此端点不接受 generation
/app/vscreen/see?coreInstance=$CORE  获取新画面及 generation、frameSeq
/app/vscreen/tap?coreInstance=$CORE&generation=$GEN&frameSeq=$FRAME&x=10&y=20
tap/swipe/touch/type/key 需要 coreInstance、generation 和最新 see 的 frameSeq；坐标按显示尺寸换算。
/app/vscreen/tree?coreInstance=$CORE  获取当前树及 nodeId、generation
/app/vscreen/node?coreInstance=$CORE&generation=$GEN&nodeId=$NODE&action=click  语义节点动作；不要求 frameSeq，使用新树中的节点
/app/vscreen/editor?coreInstance=$CORE&generation=$GEN  读取当前输入框；edit/submit 还需 editorId，edit 需 text；均不要求 frameSeq
anchor 使用原 see 的 coreInstance、generation、frameSeq、observationId 和全尺寸整数 x/y；anchored-click 使用同一组身份及 anchorId。
/app/vscreen/close?coreInstance=$CORE  关闭对应 Core；无运行中或待清理的 Core 时可省略身份
应用启动或动作后重新观察；UNKNOWN 不自动重放。

== 设备与应用 ==
/app/device                     机型/系统/电量/网络/屏幕/存储/内存
/app/apps                       全部已装应用，分用户应用与系统应用；可加 q/limit/user=1 筛选显示
/app/launch?pkg=com.tencent.mm  启动应用
/app/clip                       读剪贴板（需 App 在前台，系统限制）
/app/clip + text=…              写剪贴板
/app/readfile?path=/…          读取绝对路径的目录或文本，仍受 Android 权限限制；凭据区（.dsh/.ssh/.android）不可读
设备文件写入请走下方受保护的设备 shell；普通 Download 文件可操作，DCIM/Pictures/Android/data/obb 只读。

== 与用户交互 ==
/app/ask?options=继续|取消 + q=…  弹窗阻塞等回答（最多三个选项）
/app/notify?title=… + text=…      通知栏
/app/toast + text=…               App 内提示
/app/vibrate?ms=300               震动（长任务跑完叫醒用户）
/app/share（text= 或 path=）      分享到其它应用
/app/open?url=https://…           打开链接
/app/export?path=/root/report.md  把产物交给用户 → 落 Download/DSHA；凭据区不可导出
建议：需要用户拍板用 /app/ask 而不是干等；长任务结束用 notify 或 vibrate 叫人；
产出报告用 /app/export，别只留在容器里。

== 传感器与位置（默认关闭，需用户在配置页勾选）==
/app/location（加 fresh=1 强制重新定位，可能等数秒）
/app/sensors 列表 · /app/sensor?name=light 读值
（light 环境光 lux / accel / gyro / magnet / pressure / proximity /
 gravity / rotation 姿态四元数 / steps 开机后步数）
/app/torch?on=1 手电
这三类返回 DISABLED（用户没开该能力）或 NO_PERMISSION（没授系统权限）时，
照原话告诉用户去哪开，不要重试 —— 重试不会让开关自己变。

== 元信息 ==
/app/version                          桥协议版本 + App 版本（特性检测用）
/app/help                             本清单

== 插件状态 ==
/app/plugins                          读回上次上报的加载状态
/app/plugins?loaded=a,b&failed=c      上报（插件侧用）

== 设备 shell（自动选择 root / Shizuku / ADB）==
/root/dsh-bin/adb-shell "命令"        用 id 核验实际身份
包装命令不存在时：python3 /root/.dsh/adb-shell.py "命令"
短信只允许当前 Android 用户的 content query --uri content://sms，默认关闭；设置 → 设备能力授权可开启或撤销。
短信预授权可能返回正文及验证码；不允许发送、修改或删除，Android 仍可拒绝访问。Shizuku 不执行此敏感查询。
仅执行已识别的单条命令；允许读取各目录和明确路径的普通文件操作。禁止脚本、管道、重定向、未知命令。
根目录及系统目录只读；禁止块设备/分区、SELinux、系统设置写入、挂载和刷机操作。
结束进程前自动刷新全量用户/系统应用清单；普通用户应用直接结束，系统应用与关键进程拦截。
按完整包名调用 am force-stop / killall / pkill -x；kill 正数 PID 会核对 UID 后按包名停止。
策略拦截返回 [POLICY_BLOCKED]/126；root 和旧确认开关不能放行。不可用其它解释器或 UI 绕过。
报连不上/未配对：先看上面的 App 层接口能不能办成；确实必须 shell 才请用户到
设置 → 设备能力授权中连接可用通道，别反复试同一条命令。
不要用 /root/dsh-bin/adb 或裸 adb —— 那是守卫包装脚本，会失败。

== root（--su）==
已启用并经 root 管理器授权的 su 可直接执行，无需 ADB 配对；其次使用 Shizuku，再使用 ADB。
--su 仅在明确需要 root 时使用，须先在设备能力授权页允许；同一设备保护策略始终生效。
[EXECUTION_UNKNOWN] 表示命令可能已执行，先核对实际状态，不能切换通道或自动重放。
en:
DSHA 3090 bridge endpoints (BRIDGE_PROTOCOL=%s)
The host writes credentials to /root/.dsh/.bridge_headers. Use curl -H @/root/.dsh/.bridge_headers; keep tokens out of URLs and command arguments.
For parameters containing Chinese text or spaces, use -G --data-urlencode instead of encoding the URL manually.

== Screen control (accessibility service; no ADB/Shizuku required) ==
Coordinate gestures are limited to physical display 0. First call /app/ui/screenshot; coordinatesAvailable:true and observationId are required. dump/tree do not issue pixel credentials.
The ID applies only to the latest screenshot, within 30 seconds, and one gesture. Changes to the screen, window, occlusion or generation cause rejection.
Text/node actions return SCREEN_ACTION_SUBMITTED, actionAccepted:true, effectVerified:false only to mean Android accepted the action; this does not prove a WebView DOM change. Observe again. Before later coordinate actions, explicitly take a new screenshot. Never fall back implicitly or replay UNKNOWN results.
Read screen  curl -s -H @/root/.dsh/.bridge_headers "127.0.0.1:3090/app/ui/dump"
      → Each semantic node includes bounds. boundsHaveArea:false means there is no touchable area; do not tap its center.
Tap  curl -s -G 127.0.0.1:3090/app/ui/tap --data-urlencode "text=Settings" -H @/root/.dsh/.bridge_headers
      → Prefer tapping by text: positions change with scrolling and animation. For coordinate gestures, first obtain observationId from a screenshot (dump does not issue one), then use ?observationId=ID_FROM_SCREENSHOT&x=&y=
Semantic scroll  First call /app/ui/tree or dump for treeId, nodeId and supportedActions; use /app/ui/node?treeId=TREE_ID&nodeId=NODE_ID&action=scroll_forward (or scroll_backward). Invoke only actions listed by the node, then fetch a new tree. Accessibility acceptance does not verify that scrolling occurred; do not switch to swiping or replay unknown results automatically.
Input  curl -s -G 127.0.0.1:3090/app/ui/input --data-urlencode "text=content" -H @/root/.dsh/.bridge_headers
      → Types into the focused field. Tap an input field first if none is focused.
Key  /app/ui/key?name=back  (back/home/recents/notifications/quicksettings/lock)
Long press  /app/ui/tap?observationId=ID_FROM_SCREENSHOT&x=540&y=1200&gesture=long_press&ms=600
Double tap  /app/ui/tap?observationId=ID_FROM_SCREENSHOT&x=540&y=1200&gesture=double_tap (one Gesture / one permission)
Only single-finger gestures are supported; multi-touch and pinch are unavailable.
Swipe  /app/ui/swipe?observationId=ID_FROM_SCREENSHOT&x1=500&y1=1500&x2=500&y2=500&ms=300
Screenshot  /app/ui/screenshot   → save a PNG in the app's screenshot folder and return its path (not base64)
After each tap or input, dump the screen again before deciding the next step. Do not tap repeatedly from memory.

== Independent virtual display (Android 11+) ==
/app/vscreen/create?orientation=portrait  Create a virtual display; landscape is also supported
/app/vscreen/status  Read coreInstance, generation, displayId and status
$CORE is the coreInstance returned by create/status; $GEN is the generation from the current see or tree, $FRAME is the frameSeq from that see, and $NODE is the nodeId from that tree. Do not mix identities from different Cores or observations.
/app/vscreen/launch?coreInstance=$CORE&package=com.example.app  Launch an installed application; this endpoint does not accept generation
/app/vscreen/see?coreInstance=$CORE  Get a new image, generation and frameSeq
/app/vscreen/tap?coreInstance=$CORE&generation=$GEN&frameSeq=$FRAME&x=10&y=20
tap/swipe/touch/type/key require coreInstance, generation and the latest see frameSeq; convert coordinates to display size.
/app/vscreen/tree?coreInstance=$CORE  Get the current tree, nodeId and generation
/app/vscreen/node?coreInstance=$CORE&generation=$GEN&nodeId=$NODE&action=click  Semantic node action; frameSeq is not required; use a fresh tree node
/app/vscreen/editor?coreInstance=$CORE&generation=$GEN  Read the current editor; edit/submit also require editorId, and edit requires text; none requires frameSeq
anchor uses the original see coreInstance, generation, frameSeq, observationId and full-size integer x/y; anchored-click uses the same identity and anchorId.
/app/vscreen/close?coreInstance=$CORE  Close the corresponding Core; identity may be omitted only when no Core is running or pending cleanup
Observe again after an app launch or action; never replay UNKNOWN automatically.

== Device & apps ==
/app/device                     Model / Android / battery / network / display / storage / memory
/app/apps                       Installed apps, separated into user and system apps; filter with q/limit/user=1
/app/launch?pkg=com.tencent.mm  Launch app
/app/clip                       Read clipboard (app must be in foreground; Android restriction)
/app/clip + text=…              Write clipboard
/app/readfile?path=/…          Read a directory or text at an absolute path, subject to Android permissions; credential directories (.dsh/.ssh/.android) cannot be read
Use the protected device shell below for device file writes. Ordinary Download files are writable; DCIM/Pictures/Android/data/obb remain read-only.

== User interaction ==
/app/ask?options=Continue|Cancel + q=…  Ask in a blocking dialog (up to three options)
/app/notify?title=… + text=…      Notification
/app/toast + text=…               In-app toast
/app/vibrate?ms=300               Vibrate (notify the user after a long task)
/app/share (text= or path=)      Share to another app
/app/open?url=https://…           Open URL
/app/export?path=/root/report.md  Export an artifact to Download/DSHA; credential directories cannot be exported
Use /app/ask when a decision is needed, and notify or vibrate when a long task finishes.
Use /app/export to deliver reports; do not leave them only in the container.

== Sensors & location (off by default; enable in Configuration) ==
/app/location (fresh=1 forces a new fix; may take a few seconds)
/app/sensors lists sensors · /app/sensor?name=light reads a value
(light: ambient lux / accel / gyro / magnet / pressure / proximity /
 gravity / rotation quaternion / steps since boot)
/app/torch?on=1 Flashlight
When these APIs return DISABLED (feature off) or NO_PERMISSION (system permission missing),
Tell the user exactly where to enable it. Do not retry; retrying cannot turn the setting on.

== Metadata ==
/app/version                          Bridge protocol + app version (feature detection)
/app/help                             This endpoint list

== Plugin status ==
/app/plugins                          Read last reported loading status
/app/plugins?loaded=a,b&failed=c      Report status (for plugins)

== Device shell (selects root / Shizuku / ADB automatically) ==
/root/dsh-bin/adb-shell "command"        Use id to verify the actual identity
If the wrapper is missing: python3 /root/.dsh/adb-shell.py "command"
SMS queries only allow content query --uri content://sms for the current Android user. Off by default; enable or revoke in Device permissions.
Preauthorized SMS queries may return message bodies and verification codes. Sending, editing and deleting are blocked; Android may still deny access. Shizuku does not run this sensitive query.
Only recognized single commands are allowed, including directory reads and ordinary file operations on explicit paths. Scripts, pipes, redirects and unknown commands are blocked.
Root and system directories are read-only. Block devices/partitions, SELinux changes, system setting writes, mounts and firmware flashing are blocked.
Refresh the complete user/system app list before stopping processes. Ordinary user apps may be stopped; system apps and essential processes are protected.
Use the full package name with am force-stop / killall / pkill -x. A positive PID with kill is checked against its UID before stopping by package name.
Policy blocks return [POLICY_BLOCKED]/126. Root and legacy confirmation switches cannot override them. Do not use another interpreter or the UI to bypass a block.
If a connection or pairing error occurs, first check whether the app-level APIs above can perform the task. Only if a shell is essential, ask the user to open
Settings → Device permissions to connect an available channel. Do not keep retrying the same command.
Do not use /root/dsh-bin/adb or bare adb; those are guarded wrappers and will fail.

== root（--su）==
When su is enabled and authorized by the root manager, commands run directly without ADB pairing. Otherwise, Shizuku is used before ADB.
Use --su only when root is explicitly required and enabled in Device permissions. The same device protection policy always applies.
[EXECUTION_UNKNOWN] means the command may have executed. Verify the actual state before proceeding; do not switch connections or replay automatically.

== Phone task in the current conversation ==
When the user explicitly requests phone actions, call /app/ui/task-begin first, including app-launch-only tasks. Every request carries the real tool environment taskSessionId=$DSH_PHONE_SESSION_ID and turnId=$DSH_PHONE_TURN_ID; never invent or copy another conversation identity.
